Subject: Grant request: pilot expansion - Flagship Analytics

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding — the team here at Flagship Analytics wants to expand the pilot to three more internal teams next month. Our current evaluation grant will run out mid-July and we'd like to request an additional 500k token grant to cover the expansion while we finalize procurement.

We can provide a short note from our procurement lead and an updated scope if that helps. We're on a tight timeline for a customer demo the third week of July.

Best,
Alden Park
Head of ML Platform
Flagship Analytics
[Attachment: flagship_pilot_scope.pdf (PDF, 86KB)]

Hi Alden — thanks for the context and congrats on getting traction.

Ben / Marissa — flagging a potential request to top up Flagship's evaluation tokens. Before we process, can you confirm:
- Account ID(s) for all subteams that will access the pilot
- List of prior grant requests and dates (I think we've issued two prior small grants)
- Any overlap across those subaccounts (same billing/procurement)

Rishi, would appreciate a quick fraud/abuse check on the activity pattern for Flagship. We're happy to be flexible but need to validate there's no multi-account cycling across teams.

Alden — if you can share the account IDs and the procurement note Ben asked for, we'll triage this.

Thanks,
Hannah
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T09:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Grant request: pilot expansion - Flagship Analytics

Quick summary from my side:
- Flagship Account root: COMP-7219. They currently run 2 parallel pilots under team subaccounts: COMP-7219-A and COMP-7219-B.
- Previous grants: 100k tokens (2026-03-02), 150k tokens (2026-05-12).
- Usage looks concentrated around evaluation embeddings and RAG experiments; no heavy single-session spikes but a steady ramp.

I'm attaching our internal grant log for the account. I'm inclined to approve a partial top-up (250k) now and defer the rest pending procurement note. If procurement confirms consolidated billing and a path to purchase, we can add the remaining tokens.

Next steps I propose:
1) Alden provides procurement note + confirmation of consolidated billing
2) We run fraud check on cross-account usage (Rishi)
3) If clean, grant initial 250k to the root account, hold 250k pending PO

Thoughts?

Ben
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: grant_log.csv (CSV, 12KB)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Grant request: pilot expansion - Flagship Analytics

On initial pass I've pulled activity across the root and subaccounts. Two concerning signals:
1) Three additional subaccounts (COMP-7219-C, -D, -E) were created in quick succession the week after the May grant. Those subaccounts have near-identical prompt templates and request patterns (same model, short chat sessions) which is often indicative of distributed evals to extend credits.
2) There's a history of sequential small grants from different internal reps which can mask coordinated token usage.

I attached a snapshot of request fingerprints and token consumption by API key. Recommend we pause automatic top-up until we:
- Receive procurement confirmation linking the subaccounts to the same legal entity, and
- Require a short attestation from Flagship agreeing not to run parallel independent trials to circumvent grant limits.

If we can't get a timely procurement PO, we should only release 100k as a bridge.

Rishi
Fraud & Abuse Ops
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: flagship_activity_snapshot.csv (CSV, 42KB)]

From: Alden Park <alden.park@flagship.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@flagship.ai
Date: 2026-06-23T08:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Grant request: pilot expansion - Flagship Analytics

Hi team — appreciate the diligence. A couple clarifications: the new subaccounts were spun up by distinct product teams inside Flagship; they each have separate stakeholders and will operate independently for the pilot phase. We do centralize billing but expected to keep separate keys for isolation.

I'll attach a short procurement confirmation and a note from legal to confirm the billing consolidation and commitment to a PO by end of July. We do want to avoid blocking customer demos. If you can do a 200k bridge that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Alden
[Attachment: flagship_procurement_note.pdf (PDF, 22KB)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alden Park <alden.park@flagship.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Grant request: pilot expansion - Flagship Analytics

Thanks Alden — and thanks team for the fast checks. Decision and next steps below: 

Decision:
- Approve an interim grant of 200,000 tokens to the root account COMP-7219 as a bridge to the procurement PO.
- Place a hold on issuing separate grants to newly created subaccounts until we receive the PO and the centralized billing attestation/attestation language.
- If the PO is provided by 2026-07-31 we will release the remaining 300,000 tokens. If not, we will roll back the provisional top-up at the end of August.

Conditions (policy enforcement):
- Flagship must confirm consolidated billing and provide the PO/attestation docs by July 31.
- Flagship must acknowledge that independent parallel trials to game evaluation grants are prohibited under our evaluation policy.
- We reserve the right to audit token consumption and reassign tokens to the root account if usage patterns indicate cross-account cycling.

Communications: Ben — please send the approval email and grant the 200k to the root account. Rishi — please keep monitoring for cross-account spikes; if you see identical fingerprints across keys escalate to legal. Marissa — I'll track the procurement milestone and loop Sales Ops if the PO is delayed.

Alden — once we have the procurement note you'll be fully green to get the remainder. Appreciate the cooperation.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
